Starting in March 2022, the idea behind cuochi senza fuochi is to meet together among neighbors.

When arriving in a new city, the first thing we do is look for affordable places to sleep. 

Usually, this at least allows us to commute to work. 

With these two elements, the capital is after all guaranteed. 

But what about human capital? Is it easy to find new like-minded people among us? Working full-time is too challenging.

For that reason Cuochi senza fuochi arrived. This is the cheapest solution to meet in an affordable and offline way, new people. 
Avoid disco clubs that you don't like to meet new brains just bring some chocolate with you!
